name: SMS Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: SMS Pharmaceuticals Ltd is a diversified and integrated pharmaceutical company with interests in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) and Intermediates.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
It is an integrated pharmaceutical company specializing in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) and complex Intermediates, under various therapeutic categories including Anti-ulcer, anti-fungal, anti-migraine, anti-viral, anti-diabetic, anti-retroviral, etc. with global leadership position in 10+ therapeutic products. The company offers 45+ products to 800+ customers across 75+ countries. [1] [2]
